title: RetailSenseContracts
description: Index of every RetailSense contract model (contracts v1.0.0).

AckAction.description: What the shopkeeper did. On WhatsApp digit *i* maps to ``Alert.actions[i-1]``.
AckAction.title: AckAction

Anchor.description: Which point of a track's bbox represents the person on the floor.
Anchor.title: Anchor

Command.description: Cloud -> device instruction, piggybacked on IngestAck (HTTP) or cmd topic (MQTT).
Command.title: Command

Direction.description: Line-crossing direction; see geometry.side_of_line for the normative rule.
Direction.title: Direction

DwellSample.description: A finished visit to a zone. Deliberately carries no track id (privacy).
DwellSample.title: DwellSample

Event.description: The wire/storage envelope. Immutable once stamped.
Event.title: Event

EventClass.description: Storage/sync class of an event; drives outbox expiry + eviction (topics.EXPIRY_S).
EventClass.title: EventClass

HeatmapTiles.description: Deltas since the last flush, in floorplan cell coordinates.
HeatmapTiles.title: HeatmapTiles

HomographyConfig.description: >= 4 image/floor point pairs; ``None`` on the camera means identity.
HomographyConfig.title: HomographyConfig

lost_sale_source.default: Gruen, Corsten & Bharadwaj 2002 (GMA/FMI, 71k shoppers, 29 countries): 31% buy elsewhere, 9% abandon

queue_abandon_source.default: Retail queue studies: 32% abandon after long lines; tolerance 5-8 min

ImpactInr.description: Rupee impact with its derivation. Produced only by ``impact.py``.
ImpactInr.title: ImpactInr

Line.description: Directed line; +1 side (left of start->end, y down) is IN. See geometry.py.
Line.title: Line

Observation.description: What a producer hands to ``EdgeStore.append()``; not yet stamped.
Observation.title: Observation

statement.default: No face recognition; no raw video persisted; track IDs never leave the edge.

PrivacyManifest.description: Machine-readable statement of what RetailSense does and does not collect.

thumbnail_scope.default: shelf polygon only; never includes people

lawful_basis.default: Legitimate business purpose of the store owner (DPDP Act 2023, s.7); no personal data of shoppers is retained.

statement.default: No face recognition; no raw video persisted; track IDs never leave the edge.

PrivacyManifest.title: PrivacyManifest

RetentionPolicy.description: How long each data class lives before the purge job deletes it.
RetentionPolicy.title: RetentionPolicy

ShelfReference.description: Calibration snapshot of a full shelf (what 100 % coverage looks like).
ShelfReference.title: ShelfReference

SimTruth.description: Ground truth emitted by the synthetic store so tests can assert accuracy.
SimTruth.title: SimTruth

default.lost_sale_source: Gruen, Corsten & Bharadwaj 2002 (GMA/FMI, 71k shoppers, 29 countries): 31% buy elsewhere, 9% abandon
default.queue_abandon_source: Retail queue studies: 32% abandon after long lines; tolerance 5-8 min

default.statement: No face recognition; no raw video persisted; track IDs never leave the edge.
